text:
Maya (Customer Success): heads-up — AcmeRetail opened a high-priority ticket: after last weekend's platform rollout their search/ranking quality dropped. They say citations are missing and top results are irrelevant. Customer provided a few example queries. :rotating_light:

Priya (Support): paste from customer: 'Query: \u201creturn policy for defective earbuds\u201d -> top result is a blog about headphone maintenance, no product policy pages, citation links empty. This started after Sunday rollout (around 03:20 UTC). Our side shows many misgrounded answers.' They attached 6 failing queries.

Maya (Customer Success): they reported a 30% increase in false positives for top-1 grounding on their workload. Requesting immediate triage.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: ranking-service v4.11 -> prod @ 1862344800 (commit abc1234).

Riley (Platform): did we also flip any default embedding model or index migration? I see an embed-encoder change rule in the model catalog 1862344600 but need confirmation.

Jonah (ML Eng): I rolled ranking-service and a small default embedding bump for new indexes (embed-encoder v2.1 -> v2.2) to improve recall on long queries. They were rolled in the same window. Possible embedding compatibility issue with existing vectors.

Luca (SRE): infra checks: latency and GPU utilization normal; no infra errors. Observability: for AcmeRetail org we see an immediate ~12% drop in Top-1 relevance score and a shift in score distribution (median similarity fell from ~0.78 to ~0.34). No mass 5xx.

Priya (Support): I tried to repro with their example. Repro steps I ran:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/search \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"index":"acme_products","q":"best wireless earbuds","top_k":5}'
```
Response (truncated): top entry 'budget bluetooth headphones' score 0.12, expected ~0.86 previously. Citations array empty for top results.

Jonah (ML Eng): I reproduced locally. Running embeddings for the query with v2.1 vs v2.2 shows cosine drop ~0.4. Quick python run: 
```
# local check (pseudo)
vec_v21 = embed('best wireless earbuds', model='embed-encoder-v2.1')
vec_v22 = embed('best wireless earbuds', model='embed-encoder-v2.2')
print(cosine(vec_v21, index_top_doc))  # 0.86
print(cosine(vec_v22, index_top_doc))  # 0.43
```
That indicates embedding drift — new encoder changes geometry and existing index vectors are now mismatched.

Riley (Platform): if that's true, options: (A) rollback default to v2.1 for affected orgs, (B) schedule a reindex of AcmeRetail indexes to v2.2 vectors, or (C) enable cross-encoding reranker temporarily to compensate. Reindex is heavy and will take hours for large corpora.

Maya (Customer Success): customer is asking for mitigation ASAP — can we do a canary rollback for their org or toggle a fallback?

Jonah (ML Eng): I can push a fallback in the routing layer to use embed-encoder v2.1 for orgs that haven't reindexed. Small config change, should be low-risk. If we do that, we need to ensure the routing policy is per-org and avoid global flip. I'll prepare a patch.

Luca (SRE): I'll confirm there were no background compactions or shard migrations that could've mixed vectors during the rollout window. If none, then embedding incompatibility is the top suspect.

alerts-bot: Incident INC-2026-0784 created for 'AcmeRetail retrieval degradation' assigned to oncall team.

Priya (Support): Action items: 1) Jonah to submit config rollback to route AcmeRetail to embed-encoder v2.1 (ETA 45m), 2) Riley to validate model-catalog flags + list impacted orgs (ETA 30m), 3) Luca to confirm no index write anomalies (ETA 30m), 4) Maya to update customer with ETA and ask for the 3 most critical failing queries so we can validate.

Jonah (ML Eng): I'll also prepare a one-off reindex plan if customer wants permanent fix (estimate: 2-6 hours depending on index size).

Maya (Customer Success): I'll message AcmeRetail that we have a mitigation path (per-org fallback) and will aim to enable it within the hour. Please paste the rollback config when ready so I can reference it in the ticket. :+1:

Priya (Support): adding the three failing queries from the customer into the ticket now.

Maya (Customer Success): thanks team — please update this thread when rollback or findings are ready.

Jonah (ML Eng): starting PR for routing fallback now.

Luca (SRE): checking compaction/migration logs (running query across index ops).

[end of thread]
